A '''captive''' is a Light Side character captured by the Dark Side. Only the Dark Side may capture, and only Light Side cards; both sides can steal, which is different.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

Dark Side bounty hunters and warriors usually capture characters with cards such as Zuckuss' Snare Rifle and We Have A Prisoner, then escort them to a prison. When a character is captured the Dark Side player has three options:<ref name="gl20" />
* '''Seizure''' – a bounty hunter or warrior at the same location takes the captive into custody; the captive is placed face up beneath it.
* '''Imprisonment''' – at a prison, captives may be imprisoned beneath that prison.
* '''Escape''' – captives not seized or imprisoned escape to the Light Side player's Used Pile.

Seized or imprisoned characters cannot be released voluntarily; the Light Side can free them only with specific cards.<ref name="gl20" />
